name: EverNoise
subtitle: Your sound. No time limit.
description:
Your sound. All night.

Open EverNoise and enjoy continuous, freshly generated noise with no recording loop or time limit. Shape your sound with separate High, Mid and Low controls, from a deep rumble to a brighter wash.

Each band has six glass buttons: Off and five strengths, including a very quiet first dot for adding just a trace. Larger dots and brighter colors show the relative contribution. Changes fade smoothly, and your mix is remembered.

Consistent loudness across mixes helps you change the tone without dramatic volume jumps. App Loudness in Settings remembers your preferred output level, while smooth peak protection keeps digital peaks under control. Use your device's volume controls for everyday listening. EverNoise cannot control the loudness of other apps.

Choose your view:
• Off removes the artwork and ongoing animation work.
• Low shows a still infinity.
• Med, the default, shows a slowly flowing liquid infinity.
• High adds large, faint floating ribbons.
• Max shows a detailed spectrogram of the actual generated output. Low frequencies appear red, mids green and highs blue; brightness shows intensity.

• Starts playing when you open the app
• Background and lock-screen playback
• Mono or independent left/right Stereo; Stereo by default
• Smooth frequency-band blending and gentle frequency-edge tapers
• Large play/pause control and a quiet black interface
• Remembers your mix, App Loudness and visual preferences
• Works offline, with no accounts, ads, subscriptions or tracking
• Free, with no timer or time limit

A broad, adjustable sound for your household. Settings includes listening guidance with babies, children and pets in mind, whose hearing may differ from yours. Speaker limits still apply; EverNoise does not cover pets' entire hearing ranges. Use a quiet, comfortable level.

Available on iPhone, iPad, compatible Apple silicon Macs, Apple Vision Pro and Apple TV. System interruptions, device sleep or shutdown, and force-quitting can stop playback; the app resumes when the system permits.
promotionalText: Find your sound with separate Low, Mid, and High controls. A black screen, a quiet splash of color, and continuous playback. Free, offline, and no time limit.
reviewNotes:
EverNoise 1.1 build 30. No login, purchases, ads, tracking, or network connection required. Audio starts on launch. Three rows (High/Mid/Low) each have Off plus five active relative weights. All Off produces silence. A single active band is normalized to the same loudness at every strength; strengths control relative balance when bands are combined.

Settings: Mono/Stereo, saved App Loudness, and Off/Low/Med/High/Max visuals. Max analyzes the final generated output; it does not use the microphone. Background audio is the app's core function. Please test with the screen locked and while another app is foregrounded. Calls, other exclusive audio, and system sleep/shutdown can interrupt playback.

This update adds consistent mix loudness, slow correction and linked lookahead peak protection, practical frequency-edge tapers, a detailed spectrogram, and a quieter first mix choice. Saved mixes migrate without changing their relative weights. The app includes household listening guidance and makes no medical-treatment claims.

Validated: 55 core tests, 39 iOS integration tests, 17 tvOS integration tests, simulator UI flows on iPhone/iPad/Apple TV, all 216 mixes, Apple-engine sample-rate conversions, accelerated continuous rendering, and digital peak checks. Physical-device overnight/acoustic testing is not claimed.
ageRatingAnswers: No objectionable content, advertising, messaging, user-generated content, web browsing, gambling, contests, or purchases. External links are limited to the app support and privacy pages.
availability: Existing territories; universal iOS release for iPhone/iPad with Apple silicon Mac and Vision Pro availability; native tvOS release.
whatsNew:
• Six choices per frequency band, including a new very quiet first dot. Dots and colors now show relative strength.
• More consistent loudness when changing your mix, smooth peak protection, and a saved App Loudness setting.
• New Off and Max visual settings. Max shows a smooth, detailed spectrogram of the sound being generated.
• High, Mid and Low now follow the spectrum's vertical order, with gentle low- and high-frequency tapers.
• Updated iPad and Apple TV layouts and improved TV remote navigation.
• Your existing saved mix is preserved when upgrading.
